run_gen_build_yaml: run the python script to generate a YAML build configuration for zlib from CMakeLists.txt
run_cmpath: run the cmpath function to convert CMake paths to relative third_party/zlib paths
run_cmvar: run the cmvar function to extract CMake variable values like ZLIB_SRCS using regex
summarize_gen_build_yaml: summarize the python script that parses CMakeLists.txt and outputs a YAML build config for zlib
review_cmvar: review the cmvar function that uses regex to parse CMake set() variable definitions
